model.title: SBIC Reporting Modernization Act of 2026
model.meta: Small Business Committee · Rep. Brad Finstad (R-MN)

summary.text: The bill would require the Small Business Administration to publish a report on its website every three months about small business investment companies that hold federal licenses. Each report would include information already required in an earlier part of the law, the number of applicants approved to move to the final licensing stage, the number that also met the legal requirements for licensing, the dollar value of debentures issued under the program, and the number of jobs created or kept because of these companies' investments. The first report would be due 90 days after the bill becomes law.
